root_cause.text: The driver fails to validate that the payload size derived from the command header’s count field does not exceed the allocated buffer size, allowing an out-of-bounds read or write when accessing payload data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check `count * sizeof(u32) + offsetof(struct amdxdna_cmd, data[0]) > abo->mem.size` to ensure the calculated payload fits within the buffer. Previously only a comparison `count <= num_masks` was performed, which did not prevent a large count from referencing memory beyond the buffer.
